text: 1101 removes the standalone minidump-analyzer from the macOS file list, package manifest, Windows locked-file close list and both mac signing path sets after the upstream merge into crashreporter. A scoped accepted-source search confirms these five files no longer name minidump-analyzer and still package/sign crashreporter. Check all packaging/signing consumers for this upstream boundary. No installer, signed package or crash runtime was built.
title: Remove a merged crash utility from every owned packaging and signing list
